provenance.kind: Inspired by Xcode 27's Neon Noir theme; adapted palette with selected syntax colors matched to the original, not an Apple theme export
provenance.notes: Foreground, comment, keyword, string, number, preprocessor and the original identifier colors were recorded from the built-in Neon Noir dark preset in local Xcode 27.1, resolved through Xcode and rounded to 8-bit sRGB. Syntax mappings prioritize symbol category: functions and Zsh commands use a shared adapted soft iris blue; ordinary variables use foreground, fields use the existing soft blue, modules use the existing pale gold, and parameters use Catppuccin Mocha maroon. Only types and named constants retain declaration shades. Library origin does not override category. Separate identifier colors support UI and markup mappings. Solid backgrounds approximate the blue/violet workspace tint. UI, diagnostic and terminal colors are adaptations. No Apple theme files or binaries are redistributed. Syntax structure additionally distinguishes word operators, symbolic operators, punctuation, built-in variables and types, documentation strings, decorators and regular expressions using the existing adapted palette. Catppuccin provides the category reference; supported grammar detail varies by editor.
